name: debug build for backtrace
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cd ~/bonsai2/asm && LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -g -O1 -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -c fwd.c -o fwd_g.o 2>&1 | head -3; gcc -g -O1 -o fwd_g fwd_g.o fwd_neon.o fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm 2>&1 | head -3; which gdb || echo NOGDB' 2>&1 | head -8
